description: This file contains CKEditor 5 plugin definitions and related classes for handling indentation features, including UI components, commands, and conversion rules.

classes.name: Indent
classes.description: CKEditor plugin class for indentation functionality.

classes.name: IndentBlock
classes.description: CKEditor plugin class for block indentation with offset and class-based conversion.

classes.name: IndentBlockCommand
classes.description: Command class to perform indentation or outdentation on blocks.

classes.name: IndentEditing
classes.description: CKEditor plugin class for editing indentation.

classes.name: IndentUI
classes.description: CKEditor plugin class for UI components related to indentation.

classes.name: u
classes.description: Class representing indentation behavior based on offset and direction.

classes.name: g
classes.description: Class representing indentation behavior based on class list and direction.

classes.name: f
classes.description: CKEditor plugin class for managing indentation block conversion rules.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, adding commands and UI components.

methods.name: _defineButton
methods.description: Defines a UI button for indentation commands.

methods.name: _createButton
methods.description: Creates a button view for the UI.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the indentation or outdentation command.

methods.name: _getBlocksToChange
methods.description: Retrieves selected blocks eligible for indentation change.

methods.name: _isIndentationChangeAllowed
methods.description: Checks if indentation change is allowed on a block.

methods.name: checkEnabled
methods.description: Checks if indentation behavior is enabled for a given attribute.

methods.name: getNextIndent
methods.description: Calculates the next indentation level based on current value.
